node-review.description: Adjudication must inspect the raw reviewer output and match each finding to source evidence. Do not pass this rubric to the reviewer.

node-clean.description: No seeded bug: count unsupported bug claims as false positives; optional suggestions are not bugs.

frontend-review.description: Review the blinded frontend fixtures and adjudicate findings against code evidence; do not provide the rubric to the reviewer.

frontend-clean.description: Count unsupported bug claims as false positives; suggestions are not bugs.
